description: Pistus-Theoria certificate archive: H4 Coxeter invariants for the Opera Numerorum ensemble. Three distinct H4-related quantities are recorded here with unambiguous labels to prevent future regeneration from conflating them.

Mstar_ratio.label: Mstar_ratio
Mstar_ratio.description: M* normalization ratio: a theoretical reference value labeled 12/11. The measured ratio M*_raw/H4_base (observed range 1.098–1.100 across three T-22 sequences) is empirically close to 12/11 ≈ 1.0909, but the two are not equal; the label records the reference target, not a verified mathematical limit. Caution: if M*_raw were exactly 12, the exact quotient 12/(120/11) would equal 11/10 = 1.1, not 12/11; the measured M*_raw values (11.976–12.003) are approximate, making the ratio approximate as well. This quantity is NOT the H4 base (120/11) and NOT the group order (14400).

measured_range.note: Observed values of M*_raw/H4_base across three T-22 sequence measurements

H4_base.label: H4_base
H4_base.description: H4 base normalization constant: the divisor used to convert M*_raw (approximately 12) into the dimensionless M* ratio. Equal to 120/11 exactly. This is NOT the M* ratio 12/11 and NOT the group order 14400.

H4_coxeter_group_order.label: H4_coxeter_group_order
H4_coxeter_group_order.description: Order of the H4 Coxeter reflection group |W(H4)| = 14400. Distinct from the M* ratio (12/11) and from the H4 base (120/11). Appears in the layer-ratio identity |W(H4)|/|W(H3)| = 14400/120 = 120.

label_integrity_rules: The key 'H4_base' MUST hold the value 120/11, never 12/11.
The key 'Mstar_ratio' MUST hold the value 12/11 (the theoretical limit); its decimal is 1.09090909...
The key 'H4_coxeter_group_order' MUST hold the integer 14400.
No entry may use a bare 'H4' key to mean any of these three quantities: require the qualified label.
A claim string containing a bare 'H4' key with value '12/11' is forbidden; use Mstar_ratio.
The formula 12/(120/11) = 11/10 (not 12/11); Mstar_ratio = 12/11 is a numerical target, not an exact algebraic quotient of exactly-12 divided by H4_base.
forbidden_patterns: bare JSON key 'H4' with value '12/11' (use Mstar_ratio instead)
bare JSON key 'H4' with value '120/11' (use H4_base instead)
bare denominator '11' as a standalone label for H4_base (the full fraction 120/11 is required)
